text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. A balanced diet gives you the energy you need, so try to eat plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains. Regular exercise, such as walking or swimming, keeps your heart strong and helps you feel good. Getting enough sleep is also important, because your body and brain need time to rest. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and find time to relax. Finally, a good work-life balance helps you avoid stress and enjoy your free time. These simple habits can make a big difference.
